Apogee -- run local and cloud LLMs from one harness.

Cloud backends (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Ollama) and local inference via
llama.cpp sit behind one interface, so which model runs is configuration
rather than architecture.
Usage: apogee [OPTIONS] [SUBCOMMAND]

Options:
  -h,--help                   Print this help message and exit
  -V,--version                Print version information and exit
  --config PATH (Env:APOGEE_CONFIG)
                              Path to the config file (default: config/config.json in the data directory). Names a file only -- the data directory stays put; --custom names both
  --release Excludes: --dev --test --custom
                              Use the release channel's data directory, ~/.apogee, for this run only: the whole layout, never saved (uninstall ignores it)
  --dev Excludes: --release --test --custom
                              Use the dev channel's data directory, ~/.apogee-dev, for this run only: the whole layout, never saved (uninstall ignores it)
  --test Excludes: --release --dev --custom
                              Use the test channel's data directory, ~/.apogee-test, for this run only: the whole layout, never saved (uninstall ignores it)
  --custom PATH Excludes: --release --dev --test
                              Use the install a config file sits in, for this run only: <root>/config/<file> roots the whole layout at <root> and reads that file (uninstall ignores it)

Subcommands:
  agents                      Create and manage agent workflows (apogee analyze --agent)
  analyze                     Run a named agent workflow against an input
  auth                        Store, list, and clear provider API keys
  chat                        Start or resume an interactive conversation
  check                       Diagnose this installation
  chats                       List, inspect, and rename saved conversations
  complete                    Get a one-shot completion for a prompt
  config                      Inspect and edit the config file
  datasets                    Create, prepare, and distil training datasets
  embed                       Ingest documents into a searchable collection, and query it
  execute                     Open a session with a suite: chat's session, its symphonies playable (/play)
  graph                       Build and inspect the knowledge graph over a collection or a named graph
  knowledge, kn               Capture the why behind decisions as searchable records
  mcp                         Manage MCP tool servers
  models                      List configured models, inspect one, and show role assignments
  providers                   See which providers this machine has, and register them as backends
  reset                       Reset the data directory to a fresh install, keeping the rows you name
  serve                       Serve the OpenAI-compatible HTTP API (server deployments only)
  symphonies                  Define and play symphonies: staged prompt processes over a suite's members
  system                      Show this machine as Apogee reads it: CPU, memory, GPU, the model store's disk
  task                        Hand the application a goal: it plans, drives turns, checks and corrects
  tui                         Open the full-screen shell -- what a bare `apogee` opens at a terminal
  uninstall                   Remove Apogee, its data directory, and its completions
  version                     Print version, build, and target information
  train                       Fine-tune local models: setup, run, eval, promote, rollback, versions, status, pipeline, regime, cycle
